subject: PulseBridge DPA / SCCs / Transfer Impact — execution plan and redlines
messages:
From: Eileen Zhang <eileen.zhang@pulsebridge.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@pulsebridge.com
Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: PulseBridge - initial DPA comments and SCCs request

Lauren —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Attached are our initial DPA comments (PulseBridge_DPA_comments_2027-11-10.docx). High level asks from our counsel:

- We need confirmation you can sign the EU SCCs (controller-processor) without material edits, or provide a redline showing exceptions.
- PulseBridge requires a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) for any non-EEA processing and a list of subprocessors + contract flows.
- We flagged a 30-day deletion window for customer-managed data in some order form use cases — need confirmation on feasibility.
- Please provide SOC 2 Type II scope and most recent report (or a secure link) and any relevant encryption/KMS notes.

Can you confirm an owner on your side for DPA redlines, and whether Redwood prefers we redline your template or you will propose a clean DPA? Would like to keep contracting to two rounds if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Eileen Zhang
PulseBridge Counsel
Eileen.Zhang@pulsebridge.com

Attachments: PulseBridge_DPA_comments_2027-11-10.docx (docx, 32KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eileen Zhang <eileen.zhang@pulsebridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PulseBridge - initial DPA comments and SCCs request

Eileen / team —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. I own the DPA cadence on our side — I will:

1) Share our redlined DPA (attached) that accepts the standard SCCs with a few narrowly scoped exceptions tied to our Dedicated/private deployment model.
2) Produce a short TIA summary (what we call a transfer-impact note) and attach our subprocessor list and SOC 2 link.
3) Flag any remaining items that require internal legal/security escalation (e.g., data deletion SLAs outside standard product controls).

Next steps I propose: I will send our redline by end of day today. Karthik and Ben are on the thread for any commercial impacts (order form tie-out / 30-day deletion ask). If you're available Wednesday afternoon for a 30-min call, we can walk the exceptions.

Attaching: Redwood_DPA_template_v3-Redlines.docx

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Contracts (Sales Ops) | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template_v3-Redlines.docx (docx, 28KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-11T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PulseBridge - initial DPA comments and SCCs request

Looping in internal notes / suggested approach:

- Accept SCCs as baseline. Our redline narrows obligations around "Order-initiated deletion" to account for streaming/embedding caches and cross-region replicas — propose a 45-day operational window with an SLA exception for bulk exports.
- 30-day deletion hard requirement: commercial question. Ben to weigh in on whether we can agree to 30 days for some order forms or offer a paid add-on for expedited purge.
- TIA: Security can provide a short TIA questionnaire (see attached) + subprocessor CSV (current list attached). We should proactively include the KMS/HSM note and whether customer keys are supported in Private offering.
- Escalations: any request to change data residency guarantees or delete backups within <30 days requires Legal + Product signoff.

Attachments: TIA-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 14KB); subprocessor_list_20271111.csv (csv, 6KB)

Karthik
Sr. Privacy Engineer | Redwood Inference

(On a related note, Olga — can you confirm whether we have an up-to-date SOC 2 secure link that is ok to share with prospects under NDA?)

From: Eileen Zhang <eileen.zhang@pulsebridge.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@pulsebridge.com, procure@pulsebridge.com
Date: 2027-11-15T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: PulseBridge - redlined DPA and follow-ups

Thanks Lauren / Karthik — attached is our counsel's redline (PulseBridge_DPA_redlines_FINAL.docx). Key open items flagged on our side:

- Removal of sections we treat as "open" in the SCCs: PulseBridge counsel is requesting explicit confirmation of contract flow to downstream subprocessors in the EU exports section; they want a TIA appendix that lists backup locations and any non-EEA replication.
- Data retention / deletion window: they maintain a 30-day deletion requirement for "customer purge" requests (we noted your counter to 45 days).
- Audit evidence: request for SOC 2 Type II (latest) and a summary of encryption-at-rest / in-transit controls.

If Redwood can provide the SOC 2 link + subprocessor csv and a one-page TIA (just fields: countries, subprocessors, legal basis, mitigations), we can try to accept your redlines without a call. If not, counsel prefers a walkthrough this week.

Regards,
Eileen

Attachments: PulseBridge_DPA_redlines_FINAL.docx (docx, 24KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eileen Zhang <eileen.zhang@pulsebridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PulseBridge - redlined DPA and follow-ups (execution plan)

Eileen —

Thanks for the redline. See the execution plan below — this is intended to keep contracting to two substantive passes and a final signature:

1) Docs we provide today (attached):
   - Final short TIA summary (one page)
   - Current subprocessor list (CSV)
   - Secure SOC 2 Type II link (NDA required) — link added below
2) Items we accept in our redline: standard SCCs; responsibility allocations except for deletion SLA tweak (we propose 45 days operational purge window).
3) Items requiring escalation: any change that would require altering our order form data residency guarantees or permanent deletion of replica backups inside 30 days — Legal/Product must approve.
4) Commercial tie-out: Ben, can you confirm whether PulseBridge's procurement team would consider a one-time implementation fee or premium term for a 30-day deletion SLA?
5) Signature mechanics: we'll prepare the agreed DPA as a DocuSign envelope once PulseBridge confirms acceptance of the 45-day purge counteroffer or proposes language we can escalate.

Links / attachments:
- SOC2 (secure portal - NDA): https://secure.redwoodinference.com/reports/soc2/PULSE-2027 (access granted on request)
- DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/PULSE-DPA-20271116

Attaching: execution_checklist_20271116.md; short_TIA_summary_20271116.pdf; subprocessor_list_20271111.csv

Lauren
Head of Contracts (Sales Ops) | Redwood Inference

Attachments: execution_checklist_20271116.md (md, 3KB); short_TIA_summary_20271116.pdf (pdf, 5KB); subprocessor_list_20271111.csv (csv, 6KB)

From: Eileen Zhang <eileen.zhang@pulsebridge.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@pulsebridge.com, procure@pulsebridge.com
Date: 2027-11-16T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PulseBridge - redlined DPA and follow-ups (execution plan)

Lauren —

Appreciate the clear plan. Our counsel will review the short TIA and the SOC2 link (we will execute NDA for access). On the deletion SLA, procurement has flagged the 30-day ask as a standard requirement for our vertical; I will check with them on whether they would accept a commercial add-on.

We aim to respond with either (a) acceptance of 45-day counteroffer, or (b) a narrow 30-day requirement for specific order forms (which we will call out) by EOD Friday. If they accept the commercial tie-out, we can proceed to DocuSign.

Thanks —
Eileen
PulseBridge Counsel
